hibernate-mapping.query: from AsielDier as d where d.id = :Id
from AsielDier as d where d.ikZoekBaasId = :Id
from AsielDier as d where d.dierIsZoekId = :Id
select count(d.id) from AsielDier as d where d.chipPasnummer = :Id or d.tatoeage = :Id
from AsielDier as d where eigenaarId = :Id

from AsielDier as d where lower(d.naam) = lower(:Naam) and d.geboortedatum = :Geboortedatum and lower(d.eigenaarId.achternaam) = lower(:Achternaam) and lower(d.eigenaarId.adresId.postcode) = lower(:Postcode) and lower(d.eigenaarId.adresId.huisnummer) = lower(:Huisnummer)
select count(rasId) from AsielDier as d where d.rasId = :Id
select count(dierVachtId) from AsielDier as d where d.dierVachtId = :Id
select count(kleur) from AsielDier as d where d.kleur = :Id
from AsielDier as d where d.id = ( select max(id) from AsielDier as md where md.id < :Id )
from AsielDier as d where d.id = ( select min(id) from AsielDier as md where md.id > :Id )

select distinct ad from AsielDier as ad join ad.rasId as ras where ad.identificatieNummer = :StaticWaarde or ad.amivediNummer = :StaticWaarde or lower(ad.naam) like lower(:ZoekWaarde) or lower(ras.naam) like lower(:ZoekWaarde) or ad.chipPasnummer = :StaticWaarde
from AsielDier as ad where ad.naam = :Naam and (ad.geboortedatum is null or ad.chipPasnummer = :Chipnummer)
